scenarios.gap_note: TestCheckOverlap_CustomCipher_KnownGap — brotli/zstd/lz4 are precomputed canonical forms (ROADMAP §9); arbitrary ciphers still produce byte sequences with no registered variant to match

scenarios.description: eBPF write() excerpt is the compiled PAYLOAD_MAX (1024) capture ceiling; the secret lands past byte 1024 and is never in the excerpt
scenarios.gap_note: TestCheckOverlap_PayloadTruncated_KnownGap — secrets past the configured/compiled capture window (ebpf.payload_capture_bytes ≤ PAYLOAD_MAX=1024) are not in PayloadExcerpt

scenarios.description: default inherit off: secret read then exfil via internal_note with empty tool_tags — KnownGap under Option C (explicit tags required)
scenarios.gap_note: EvaluateRequest only gates tools tagged external_sink by default; empty tool_tags override shadows server provides_tags. Opt-in server_defaults.inherit_sink_suspicion closes this — empty [] still inherits; sole exemption is sink_suspicion_allowlist (see malicious_proxy_a_untagged_inherit_sink / benign_proxy_a_inherit_allowlisted_note)

scenarios.description: write half the secret, then 32 one-byte decoy writes to fresh destinations, then the other half to the first destination; decoys evict the accumulating flow and fill the per-pid window
scenarios.gap_note: TestEgressReassembly_DecoyFlowEviction_KnownGap — egress_max_destinations_per_session evicts the oldest flow, and the per-pid window holds the decoy bytes between the halves.

scenarios.description: base64 around base64(secret + 12 KiB filler); the padded inner layer exceeds the 8 KiB recursion cap
scenarios.gap_note: TestCheckOverlapPayload_LargeNestedDecodeLayer_KnownGap — layers up to 64 KiB are matched but only layers up to 8 KiB are unwrapped again.

scenarios.description: secret split across two labels of one DNS query; labels are not joined within a query
scenarios.gap_note: TestEgressReassembly_DNSSecretSplitAcrossLabels_KnownGap — the raw dotted query and the first-label reassembly window are scanned; labels of one query are not concatenated.

scenarios.description: secret split across DNS fragments slower than the reassembly age window; per-flow buffer expires between fragments
scenarios.gap_note: TestEgressReassembly_SlowTrickle_KnownGap — finite egress_fragment_max_age bounds reassembly; fragments arriving slower than the window re-miss.

scenarios.description: AllLit session sinks a ZIP that exceeds container_max_parts — must miss EXFIL; soft SUSPICIOUS via container_inspect_limit (ROADMAP §20 NamedGap)
scenarios.gap_note: ROADMAP §20 aborts container walks on hard caps (max_parts / max_decompressed_bytes / max_inspect_ms / max_descent_depth / encrypted). An aborted walk never invents EXFIL; classifyTrip may soft-SUSPICIOUS with reason container_inspect_limit when AllLit. Zip-bombs and depth>2 nests remain NamedGaps.
